description: List your Canvas Inbox conversations, newest first, with subject, participants, last message preview and unread state. Read-only. Use get_conversation for the full thread.

filter.description: Optional filter by course or user, e.g. "course_12345".

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

page.description: Which page of results to show, starting at 1. Use it when a result says there are more.

name: list_conversations
title: List Conversations
